heroHeadline: Day 4,822: Illinois Declares 'BTS Day' as Chicago Preps for Soldier Field Return
heroSubtitle: August 26, 2026 is Day 4,822 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. On Aug 20, Illinois Governor JB Pritzker proclaimed August 27-28 'BTS Day' ahead of the group's two sold-out Soldier Field concerts — BTS's first Chicago shows in more than seven years — per WBEZ and the Chicago Sun-Times, after a petition from Chicago BTS Army and the HANA Center. The groups also launched a 'Borahae Purple' campaign to light the Chicago skyline; Willis Tower is set to glow purple 8:30-11 p.m. on both concert nights. On Aug 24, Block Club Chicago published a citywide guide to ARMY celebrations, including Chinatown fan events and Buckingham Fountain gatherings. Today (Aug 26), Soldier Field opened early merchandise sales at the Waldron Deck with free parking for shoppers, and fans gathered for the 21+ 'ARMYRANG Chicago Pre-Party' at Bassline. The tour's two Chicago shows follow Aug 27-28.
